# liboqs / fuzz_test_kem

liboqs's own fuzz target `fuzz_test_kem` ([source](source/fuzz_test_kem.c), unmodified), one of the targets OSS-Fuzz builds, over liboqs (open-quantum-safe/liboqs at 8979276a).

Checks one property, a round trip: KEM correctness: for the fuzz-selected algorithm (all OQS_KEM_algs) and a fuzz-seeded RNG, keypair -> encaps -> decaps and the decapsulated shared secret must equal the encapsulated one byte-for-byte.

## How this program differs from what OSS-Fuzz runs
- Linked against liboqs at commit 8979276a.
- In every build, getenv() returns NULL, getpid() returns 1 and mkstemp() uses a fixed name, so the program depends only on its input.
- A small driver reads the input file, calls the harness one to four times and prints each return value.

## What the harness checks
- KEM correctness: for the fuzz-selected algorithm (all OQS_KEM_algs) and a fuzz-seeded RNG, keypair -> encaps -> decaps and the decapsulated shared secret must equal the encapsulated one byte-for-byte ([line 124](source/fuzz_test_kem.c#L124)): assert(); confirmed in the binary.

A failed check marked as ending the process contradicts every halts statement below, so a proof of one implies it on every input it covers.

Static riscv64 Linux programs, compiled for RV64G and run as `<file> <input-file>`; `oft fetch liboqs` downloads the published ones and checks each against its SHA-256.

Each build also links code that no sanitizer instruments, as its link recorded it. A statement about a sanitizer build covers that code only as uninstrumented code: ASan checks no load or store made inside it, and UBSan inserts no check there.

- plain: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library)
- ubsan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library)
- asan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.asan.a` (the sanitizer runtime), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime)
